Resolves #20424

Manual JSON Neural Link launches now pass the Brain runtime root while keeping the Engine as their target. The Claude Desktop example also resolves all four executables from Brain, preserving the Engine `.env`, credential slots and remote transport shape.

Evidence: L3 (actual isolated MCP children connected to a test-owned Bridge) → L3 required (manual JSON launch). Residual: none in the source/launch scope; no installed-seat migration or Bridge-spawn claim.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Parsed Quick Start JSON preserves the target `cd` and adds only `--cwd <YOUR_BRAIN_REPO_PATH>`; actual launch succeeds from a third, unrelated cwd. |
| AC-2 | Four example executable paths resolve in Brain; all target `--env-file` arguments and other fields are unchanged. Parsed Neural Link runtime argument names Brain; tracked placeholder census finds no obsolete Engine `ai/` path. |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI paired real-child controls below: old Quick Start initializes but stays disconnected; corrected Quick Start connects once and reports the owned test port. |

## Deltas from ticket

The author [folded the live reference correction into the ticket](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20424): `.codex/config.template.toml` references the Claude example, so it is preserved and corrected. The [claimer's Contract Ledger](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20424#issuecomment-6690489288) records the two root authorities. Six line replacements in the two existing files; no runtime module, Codex template or Fleet change.

## Test Evidence

Outside-CI, following the [predecessor's isolated launch recipe](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20419): parse the actual old/corrected JSON entries; substitute a temporary target, the distinct Brain checkout and an absolute Node executable; launch from an unrelated third cwd. A test-owned `WebSocketServer` on an allocated loopback port sends `createBridgeInfoPayload()`.

| Actual child | MCP initialize | Bridge connections | Health / exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Old Quick Start | succeeds | 0 | disconnected / EOF exit 0 |
| Corrected Quick Start | succeeds | 1 | connected, matching test port, no `cwdFinding` / EOF exit 0 |
| Old Claude example | fails | 0 | obsolete target `ai/` module missing / exit 1 |
| Corrected Claude example | succeeds | 1 | connected, matching test port, no `cwdFinding` / EOF exit 0 |
| Corrected example with deliberately wrong target `--cwd` | succeeds | 1 | `BRIDGE_CWD_MISSING_SCRIPT` / EOF exit 0 |

The last control bounds the claim: connecting to an already-listening Bridge does not alone prove runtime-root validity. Parsed arguments, real executable existence and the absence of that diagnostic establish the corrected roots.

Isolation uses an explicit credential-free child environment, disposable HOME/ZDOTDIR/storage, `NEO_NL_PORT`, and the existing Brain `test/playwright/configTemplateResolver.mjs` preload. `NEO_TEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATES=true`, its explicit `runner` scope and storage root keep ignored operator overlays out; `createDiagnosticPathAttestation()` confirms both resolved writable sinks before startup. Every initialized child emitted the matching attestation, exited on stdin EOF and left zero active test sockets. Temporary roots were removed after cleanup.

Source binding: Engine base `268b527d305415528d9a97985987e42be02f229f`; Brain `ee775ff2edfd1ed721e004de1056fc00ea853fe3`; Node 25.9.0. SHA-256 checks of both candidate files and the seven Brain entrypoint/config/connection/protocol/isolation inputs were identical before and after the paired run. JSON comparison, executable existence, relative links and whitespace pass.

An existing manual user applies the corrected entry at their next MCP relaunch and checks connection health. The source repair does not update installed configs; Fleet-managed seats already receive the runtime argument.

**Verdict:** Approved

- All three distinct executables exist at Brain `dev`: `ai/mcp/client/stdioToStreamableHttp.mjs`, `ai/mcp/server/github-workflow/mcp-server.mjs` and `ai/mcp/server/neural-link/mcp-server.mjs`.
